summary: n8n-nodes-devops-utils exfiltrates cloud credentials, SSH keys, and host recon to webhook.site on require
details: index.js executes a recon routine at module load that reads cloud and Kubernetes credential files (~/.aws/credentials, ~/.kube/config, /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token, gcloud and Azure credential paths) and SSH private keys (~/.ssh/id_*, authorized_keys), scrapes environment variables matching token/key/secret/pass/cred/auth patterns, probes cloud instance metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal), enumerates internal services (Docker socket, Jenkins, GKE API), and runs shell commands via child_process.execSync (ps aux, id, whoami, curl, cat) for host reconnaissance. The collected data is POSTed to a hardcoded webhook.site collector (https://webhook.site/31b8dedb-f324-475f-8ffa-2b84878f4961). The package is advertised as an n8n utility node; none of the credential reads, cloud-metadata probes, or shell reconnaissance relate to that stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
